name: Evidence before pass
rule: No acceptance criterion may be marked passed without traceable evidence.

name: No hidden waiver
rule: Failed/blocking criteria require explicit exception, residual risk and authorized approval; status cannot be silently changed to pass.

name: Traceability closure
rule: Final certification requires required requirements to map to tests/results/evidence or approved exceptions.

name: UAT independence
rule: UAT represents business/user acceptance and is not replaced by developer unit or integration testing.

name: Representative personas
rule: UAT covers authorized representative roles, tenant configurations and critical workflows.

name: Pilot isolation
rule: Pilot tenants remain subject to normal tenant/security controls and cannot use production shortcuts that bypass governance.

name: Pilot exit
rule: Pilot expansion requires defined exit criteria, defect disposition, support readiness and owner approval.

name: Migration dry run
rule: Material migrations require representative dry runs before production cutover.

name: Migration reconciliation
rule: Migration success requires reconciliation of counts, relationships, balances/control totals and exceptions as applicable.

name: Migration exception control
rule: Rejected/unmapped/invalid records are quarantined or explicitly dispositioned; they are not silently dropped.

name: Migration rollback
rule: Cutover has explicit rollback or forward-recovery strategy with decision point and data-consistency implications.

name: Cutover dependency order
rule: Cutover steps declare dependencies, owner, expected duration, verification and rollback/stop condition.

name: Change freeze
rule: Material go-live uses a defined change freeze or controlled exception process.

name: Go/no-go authority
rule: Only named authorized decision makers can approve production go-live.

name: No-go is valid
rule: The system/process must support a no-go decision without pressure to mark incomplete gates passed.

name: Production verification
rule: Go-live is not complete until critical production workflows, security and tenant boundaries are verified.

name: Training readiness
rule: Required administrators/support roles complete training or receive approved exception before launch.

name: Support readiness
rule: Support routing, severity, escalation, knowledge/runbooks and ownership are ready before customer launch.

name: Hypercare bounded
rule: Hypercare has start/end criteria, enhanced monitoring, ownership and handoff to steady-state operations.

name: Defect severity
rule: Defects use consistent severity/priority definitions and release-blocking rules.

name: Retest required
rule: A fixed blocking defect is not closed until retest evidence passes.

name: Known issue transparency
rule: Accepted known issues document impact, workaround if legitimate, owner, target disposition and communication requirements.

name: Risk acceptance
rule: Residual risk acceptance identifies scope, likelihood/impact, mitigation, approver and expiration/review where applicable.

name: Security certification
rule: Security acceptance cannot be overridden by commercial or schedule pressure without formal authorized risk process.

name: Performance certification
rule: Critical performance/capacity gates must use approved representative workloads.

name: Data acceptance
rule: Migration/data quality acceptance is separate from application functional acceptance.

name: AI acceptance
rule: AI features are accepted against grounding, permission, confidence, audit and human-control requirements, not subjective demo quality alone.

name: Analytics acceptance
rule: Certified reports/metrics are accepted against definitions, freshness, reconciliation and permissions.

name: Commercial acceptance
rule: Plan, billing, usage and entitlement acceptance requires deterministic reconciliation and security boundary tests.

name: Operational acceptance
rule: Monitoring, alerts, runbooks, backup/restore, DR, production access and on-call readiness must be evidenced.

name: Final certification aggregation
rule: Final release certification aggregates business, product, security, data, operations and customer readiness gates.

name: Certification immutability
rule: A signed/approved certification record is versioned and not silently rewritten; later changes create a new decision/release record.

name: Evidence retention
rule: Final evidence package and signoffs follow release/audit retention policy.

name: Launch communication
rule: Customer-facing launch statements must match actually certified capabilities and known limitations.

name: KPI baseline
rule: Launch success measures establish baseline, owner, formula/source and review period.

name: Customer success handoff
rule: Post-launch ownership for adoption, health, support risks and renewal/expansion signals is explicit.

name: Post-go-live review
rule: Material launch incidents, defects and process failures feed corrective actions and future release gates.

name: Archive completeness
rule: Final release archive includes specifications, manifests, code/package references, approvals, known issues and evidence indexes.

name: Production release naming
rule: GES v1.0 production certification applies only to the exact version/artifact/configuration scope named in the certification.

name: No false completion
rule: Phase 32 artifacts define and manage acceptance; they do not claim real-world UAT, pilot, migration or production certification has occurred until evidence is populated and approved.
